business_summary: BNY Mellon Municipal Bond Infrastructure Fund, Inc. is a closed ended fixed income mutual fund launched and managed by BNY Mellon Investment Adviser, Inc. The fund invests in the fixed income markets of the United States. It primarily invests in the tax-exempt investment grade debt obligations issued by or on behalf of states, territories and possessions of the United States and the District of Columbia and their political subdivisions, agencies and instrumentalities, or multistate agencies or authorities, and certain other specified securities. The fund invests its bonds issued by infrastructure sector including transportation, energy and utilities, social infrastructure, water and environment, and other similar public sectors which are rated as BBB- and above by S&P and Fitch and Baa3 and above by Moody's with an effective duration of up to 14 years.  It employs fundamental and quantitative analysis with a bottom-up security picking approach by focusing on factors such as the relative value and attractiveness of various sectors and securities to seek to exploit pricing inefficiencies in the municipal bond market, actively trading among various sectors based on their apparent values, general economic and monetary conditions, prevailing interest rates and the condition of the general money market and the municipal bond market, the size of a particular offering, the maturity of the obligation, and the rating of the issue to create its portfolio. The fund was formerly known as Dreyfus Municipal Bond Infrastructure Fund, Inc. BNY Mellon Municipal Bond Infrastructure Fund, Inc. was formed on April 25, 2013 and is domiciled in the United States.
business_summary_ko: BNY Mellon Municipal Bond Infrastructure Fund, Inc.는 BNY Mellon Investment Adviser, Inc.가 출시하고 관리하는 폐쇄형 채권 뮤추얼 펀드입니다. 이 펀드는 미국 채권 시장에 투자합니다. 주로 미국의 주, 준주, 속령, 컬럼비아 특별구, 정치적 하부 기관, 기관 및 대행 기관, 다주 기관 또는 당국, 특정 기타 특정 증권에 의해 발행되거나 이를 대신하여 발행된 면세 투자 등급 채무 채권에 투자합니다. 이 펀드는 S&P와 Fitch가 BBB- 이상, Moody's가 Baa3 이상 등급을 받은 교통, 에너지 및 공공 시설, 사회 기반 시설, 수자원 및 환경을 포함한 인프라 부문과 기타 유사한 공공 부문에서 발행한 채권을 최대 14년 동안 유효 기간으로 투자합니다.  지방채 시장의 가격 비효율성을 활용하기 위해 다양한 섹터와 증권의 상대적 가치와 매력 등의 요소에 초점을 맞추고, 겉보기 가치를 기반으로 다양한 섹터 간 거래를 활발히 수행하는 상향식 증권 피킹 접근 방식으로 근본적이고 정량적 분석을 사용합니다.
